Welcome!
Welcome to my party!{VAR BE01}
Please enjoy conversations
with everyone!

This move makes your Pokémon
unbearably charming!{VAR BE01}
All Pokémon of the opposite gender
will fall in love!

Did you see the dress that the
supermodel, Elesa, was wearing?{VAR BE01}

Whatever Elesa wears is beautiful.
A stunning ensemble!

Ciao!
Ti stai divertendo?{VAR BE01}
Non sentirti in imbarazzo.
Parla pure con chi vuoi.

It's hard to get up the morning after
a fun day like today.

I've asked my Pokémon to use Sing
instead of setting an alarm clock.{VAR BE01}
But I cannot get up at all.
I don't know why.
